technique: Brace the trunk, set the bar on the upper back, and unlock hips and knees together.
Descend until thighs reach at least parallel while keeping heels down and knees tracking over mid-foot.
Drive up by extending hips and knees without losing lumbar neutrality.
setup: Rack height at mid-chest; step under the bar; create upper-back shelf; walk out with short steps.
breathing: Inhale and brace before descent; forceful exhale near lockout or use a brief Valsalva on heavy sets.
safety: Use collars; clear spotters/safety pins; stop if sharp knee or spine pain.
contraindications: Acute lumbar disc flare without clearance

regressions.note: Learn depth and brace with goblet load
